_note: SKILLS REGISTRY — the single source that VETS which plugin skills a role may bind, exactly as connectors.json vets MCP. The skills themselves live IN-REPO as a Claude Code plugin (plugins/magnet-baron-skills/) shipped via the repo-hosted marketplace (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json), so they are plug-and-play and admin-managed. A role binds a skill by its plugin:skill id under a host block in config/roles.json; bin/generate-roles.py resolves every bound id against THIS registry AND the on-disk SKILL.md and FAILS CLOSED (the H1 pattern used for MCP): a skill absent here is UNVETTED and may not be bound; a kind:write skill may not reach a read_only role; a role's seat that lacks the skill's required_capability aborts generation and the review gate. NO secrets — ids and capability names only. Fields per skill: description (human summary); kind (read|write — write gated off read_only seats); required_capability (a coarse tag from providers.json `capabilities`, OR an MCP/store connector name from connectors.json `mcp_connectors` checked against that connector's `available_on` for the role's seat, OR null for no gate); hosts (which host agents may carry it).

plugin_source.resolves_to: plugins/<plugin>/skills/<skill>/SKILL.md — bin/generate-roles.py resolves the plugin dir through the repo marketplace, so the in-repo skill is host-discoverable and the id never dangles.

magnet-baron-skills:shopify-theme.description: Conventions and safe-change workflow for the Magnet Baron Sense-based Shopify theme (sections, snippets, blocks, assets, templates, locales).
magnet-baron-skills:shopify-theme.note: Capability-gated, not seat-gated: any implement seat listed in connectors.json shopify-mb-internal.available_on may carry it, and only while that connector's status is active. A primed/ready/missing Shopify connector does not satisfy this write skill gate, even if the connector name is copied into providers.json capabilities. Pair with Review D (Website Visual QA) when storefront pixels change.

magnet-baron-skills:web-coding.description: Modern web-app coding standards: project structure, dependencies, testing, security, and review-ready diffs.

magnet-baron-skills:mobile-app.description: Mobile-app coding standards for iOS, Android, and cross-platform work: architecture, platform conventions, state/data, testing, and store release.

magnet-baron-skills:seo-ops.description: Read-only, brand-separated SEO research and reporting for Magnet Baron and Gadget Duke via Search Console and DataForSEO MCP.
magnet-baron-skills:seo-ops.note: Read-only invariants are enforced by the binding role (seo-research: read_only + every mutating gsc-indexing tool denied), not by this registry. required_capability is null because the skill's live data access is host-scoped MCP (gsc-indexing/dfs-mcp on the claude host), already vetted by the connectors.json H1 mutation map.

magnet-baron-skills:naming.description: Request-driven, read-only generation and brandability/availability screening of business, brand, and product names against only the item's intrinsic hard limits.
magnet-baron-skills:naming.note: Read-only invariants are enforced by the binding role (naming: read_only + Write/Edit/Bash/Admin/publish denied), not by this registry. required_capability is null because verification is host-scoped read-only MCP (dataforseo/dfs-mcp on the claude host, already vetted by the connectors.json H1 mutation map) plus WebSearch/WebFetch; the optional grokbot visual lane is manual, owner-gated Slack and grants no capability. Dynamic skill: it enforces only the hard limits intrinsic to the specific item being named and flexes everything else to the brief.
